description: This file declares utilities for handling ISO8601 date and time formats, including functions to generate current time strings, convert between unix time and ISO8601 format, validate date strings, and format uptime. It also defines constants for unknown time representation.

methods.name: iso8601_cur_time
methods.description: Retrieves the current time in ISO8601 format into the provided buffer.

methods.name: iso8601_from_unix_time
methods.description: Converts a unix timestamp to an ISO8601 string representation.

methods.name: iso8601_strftime
methods.description: Formats a 'struct tm' into an ISO8601 date string.

methods.name: iso8601_us_strftime
methods.description: Formats a 'struct timeval' into an ISO8601 date-time string with microsecond precision.

methods.name: iso8601_is_valid
methods.description: Checks if a given date string is a valid ISO8601 date.

methods.name: iso8601_to_unix_time
methods.description: Parses an ISO8601 date string and returns the corresponding unix timestamp.

methods.name: uptime_strftime
methods.description: Formats an uptime value into a human-readable string.
